fields.name: is rx
fields.description: To change the Rx Verified option, you must have the applicable permissions. This box indicates that an allergy has been verified by a user with security privileges to do so (typically the pharmacist). If a user without security privileges to verify allergies makes certain changes to a verified allergy, the allergy status becomes unverified. The Pharmacy Specification Master defines which changes create a status change of an allergy from Rx verified to Rx unverified.
